Definition: of uncertain affinity; deep or open sea, i.e. the main:--depth, sea.
BiblicalUsage: Pelagos is the deep sea, the open main. Paul sailed over the sea of Cilicia and Pamphylia on his way to Rome, and Jesus says it would be better for a man who offends a little one to be drowned in the depth of the sea.
TheologicalSignificance: I am sure that the deep sea is a picture of judgment too great to escape — and of a mercy that still carries Paul through it.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
